scripts.link: bun run --filter @vein/cli build && bun run --filter @vein/cli link && bun run --filter @vein/web build && bun run --filter @vein/web link
scripts.unlink: bun run --filter @vein/cli unlink && bun run --filter @vein/web unlink
scripts.dev:web: bun run --filter @vein/web build:backend && bun run --filter @vein/web start
scripts.lint:hex: sh -c '! grep -rq "\[#" packages/web/src/client/' || (echo 'ERROR: hardcoded hex colors found in web client' && exit 1)
